evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: Contrasts owned vs. rented along a proportionality axis — value retained vs. value leased — enacting market-pricing as the relational frame for intelligence.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Framing perspective as a retained asset against a commoditized substrate carries forward the owned-vs-rented proportionality distinction.
